base:
Create a realistic, production-quality Chinese desktop web-app UI mockup for Prompt Sidecar. Single image, target 1440 x 1024, current date 2026-11-18. It is a DESIGN MOCK with sample data, not a screenshot of a running implementation. Preserve established blue #3157d5, light pale blue #edf1ff and white background, slate text #172033; polished restrained product typography at 14–16px baseline, comfortable whitespace, subtle separators, little shadow. STRICT USER REQUIREMENTS: exactly TWO content columns, NO sidebar/rail/third column, NO full-width session information strip. A slim brand header above the two columns is fine. Never repeat session identity, context status, counts, platform/model data in multiple locations. DO NOT show message counts ('34条消息') or context character counts anywhere on the main screen. DO NOT have multiple sections titled 会话上下文; avoid that redundant title entirely. Main focus is quick conversation selection → prompt polishing or next-step analysis → edit/copy/send into that conversation. This is NOT an empty-state mock; show useful filled state.

Slim header: 'Prompt Sidecar', subtle subtitle '写好下一条消息', right read-only '润色模型 · gpt-6-astra' and small '设置' button. NO model dropdown and no invented formatting toolbar. Left column includes a prominent SINGLE session chooser with platform 'Codex' and title '分析本地 Agent 中枢架构', change action '切换会话'. One secondary project/path line 'AgentXRay · …/aicode_library/AgentXRay' and compact '详情' affordance (full ID, context preview, connection diagnostics and target-model details live inside details, not visible elsewhere). Small connected indicator can appear only once in this chooser. NO duplicated identity in the header, progress section, send footer or page bottom.

Left primary section '原始草稿' with editable large textarea containing '帮我梳理本地 Agent 中枢架构，找出当前实现的缺口，并给出下一步建议。', small '填入示例' action, character count without fabricated max limit and '⌘ Enter 润色'. Checked checkbox '结合会话内容'. CRITICAL FOUR MODE CONTROLS MUST BE ALWAYS VISIBLE BELOW DRAFT: '快速' '结构化' 'Agent' '系统提示词', with 结构化 selected. Output settings are a compact single expandable row '输出规则 · 精简 · 结论 / 变更 / 验证 / 限制 / 下一步'; allow edit through '调整' affordance. Two distinct actions: solid blue '润色草稿', secondary '分析下一步'. Small collapsed optional row '补充任务信息' with subtle 'AgentXRay · 可选'; NO huge integration banner, NO JSON on main surface.

Right column contains:
1. '当前进展': one or two sentences ONLY, e.g. '已梳理会话读取和消息投递链路；还需确认模块边界与异常处理。' Do not turn this into dashboard metrics or six evidence cards.
2. '建议下一步': concrete action AND why, e.g. '先核对调度、执行和记忆模块的边界，避免开发时职责重叠。' Do not repeat full task title.
3. '需要你决定的事项': CONDITIONAL ONLY. Omit completely in ordinary normal state; no empty section, no '暂无' filler, no '无阻塞' badge. Show this only when scenario explicitly includes unresolved blocker, missing information, or conflict.
4. '可发送提示词': large EDITABLE plain text box, dominates right column below brief progress and recommendation. Sample prompt: '请基于当前代码核对调度、执行与记忆模块的职责和调用关系。\n\n列出职责重叠与接口缺口，并引用对应代码作为依据。\n\n先给出最小调整方案和验证方法；如存在需要选择的实现方向，请明确列出。' Brief progress and rationale are outside this box, not mixed with prompt editing.
Below editable box: small secondary '复制' '恢复原文' '重新润色' controls and '自动复制' checkbox. Delivery footer inside SAME right column: '发送方式 · 排队' (Codex ONLY supports queue; DO NOT offer 插入/steer), solid blue primary '发送到当前会话', tiny note '编辑确认后发送'. No duplicate target title/platform in send footer. Explicit click required; never automatic send. Do not show fake actual execution model before send; actual model is a conditional receipt detail only after a real send.

No marketing hero, no enormous art/illustration, no invented features, no graphs, no third column, no sidebar nav, no repeated context counters, no browser chrome, no decorative pagination, no English design direction titles. Keep all controls and texts fully visible without clipping.
variations: Direction name: Calm parallel composition. EXACTLY two equal-width columns separated by a generous gutter; left is session choice and authoring, right is readable compact progress+recommendation block above editable output and anchored delivery controls. Ordinary state: no blocker and no decision section at all. Use clear typography and horizontal dividers rather than many nested cards. Slightly more weight on editable result. Single conversation chooser only inside top of LEFT column.

Direction name: Send-first workbench. Still STRICTLY EXACTLY TWO columns, left 42% width for choosing session and drafting, right 58% width for current progress, next step and editable prompt. Single slim session selector inside left column, not spanning both. Normal unblocked state OMIT decision section completely. On RIGHT, show progress and next step as two brief stacked text rows with clear headings, not side-by-side (no mini third column). Use one large unified result surface, plain-text editor taking most of right area. Anchor Send button next to copy at bottom of right editor, queue label once. On LEFT keep mode segmented controls and output-rule summary immediately below textarea and the two authoring actions visible, optional AgentXRay import compact. Calm airy white/blue with slim dividers, no duplicated status at bottom or header. Do not omit primary polish button.

Direction name: Decision-aware continuation. EXACTLY TWO content columns, balanced 46% left and 54% right. Similar clear white/blue two-pane authoring tool, no extra rail. This mock explicitly shows the CONDITIONAL exception state (missing architecture choice). RIGHT section sequence: 当前进展 (one sentence), 建议下一步 (one action with reason), a compact pale AMBER inline notice titled '需要你决定的事项', then large editable 可发送提示词 box and copy/send footer. Decision text: '现有记录尚未确定采用独立调度器，还是沿用现有入口。请先确认方向。' This is a clarifying question not a failure banner or an empty state. The prompt in editor for THIS state is an editable clarification message: '请先确认调度模块的接入方式：采用独立调度器，还是沿用现有入口？确认后再细化模块边界与验证方案。' Therefore sending is ALLOWED (it sends the question after user click, not autonomous implementation). Do not disable sending unnecessarily, no buttons that execute implementation. Keep '复制' and primary '发送到当前会话' at bottom, queue only. LEFT contains all standard session selector, draft, persistent FOUR modes, compact output rules, blue 润色草稿 and secondary 分析下一步 actions, compact optional task import. Do not repeat same missing-choice text in recommendation: recommendation can be '先确认接入方向，再核对接口，避免错误假设带来返工。' No repeated message/context counts anywhere.
